name: Event-Driven Orders Platform
description: A .NET 10 microservices backend using CQRS and the Outbox pattern over Kafka, deployed to Kubernetes with Argo CD GitOps. Demonstrates clean/onion architecture and reliable event delivery.

name: Angular Micro-Frontend Shell
description: A module-federation shell that composes independently deployable Angular micro-frontends behind a shared design system and auth layer, with CI/CD wired for independent team delivery.

name: Serverless Media API
description: A React front-end backed by AWS Lambda and S3, delivering signed uploads and on-the-fly image processing — a compact example of a cloud-native, full-stack serverless workflow.
